description: UK Centre for Ecology & Hydrology publishes MaRIUS-G2G-WAH2-daily, an ensemble of modelled river flows for Great Britain. Grid-to-Grid is driven by weather@home2 climate-model inputs to produce 100 members of daily mean flow in cubic metres per second for 260 gauged catchments. The repository identifies historical 1900–2006, near-future 2020–2049 and far-future 2070–2099 periods. It also lists a baseline as 1975–2005, while the describing paper uses 1975–2004; that discrepancy remains unresolved. EIDC distributes CSV files under the UKCEH Click-Through Licence, which permits royalty-free personal or internal business use but restricts redistribution and commercial derivative services. No account or files were accessed. Future runs follow the high-emission RCP8.5 scenario described by the paper. They are scenarios, not forecasts and retain climate-model and hydrological-model uncertainty. Modellers could use the ensemble to stress-test reservoir or water-supply reliability. It complements observation-driven MaRIUS series by sampling plausible alternative weather sequences and future conditions.
